name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.1.

Updating is calmer now. While ASVA installs a new version it shows a clear screen: "Updating - I will close and reopen by myself in about a minute. Your customers, bills and reminders are safe." When it comes back it confirms "you are up to date, nothing was lost." No more wondering whether the app disappeared while it updated.

Everything from 2.0 is included: your privacy locked down (only your own customers' messages ever reach ASVA), a smarter assistant that welcomes a lead once then hands the chat to you, the Today home, trade-based due dates, and a fairer reliability score.
